reason: The question asks specifically whether the named legacy Freddie Mac Small Balance Loan (SBL) program is open for a new application dated September 7, 2026. Per the April 15, 2026 announcement, applications under the former Small Balance Loan program were accepted only through April 30, 2026, so that named legacy program was closed as of the September 7, 2026 application date. This is a program-availability determination for the named legacy program, not an adverse assessment of the deal. Separately, the $3 million amount does fall inside the disclosed $2 million to $10 million range for the successor Freddie Mac Conventional Small offering, and Fannie Mae Conventional is also a possible alternative route, but the source explicitly does not state a complete set of current underwriting criteria for Conventional Small and both sources state guidelines do not establish approval of a specific borrower. No explicit actual approval evidence exists in the packet, so approved remains false. Any redirection to a successor or alternative program would need its own separate eligibility review rather than being inferred from the amount range alone.
missing_information: Whether any transition, pipeline, or grandfathering exception exists for applications initiated before the April 30, 2026 SBL cutoff

Occupancy and stabilization status, including whether 90% occupancy for 90 days is met or whether pre-stabilized case-by-case consideration would be needed
